Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.description:
Writes a file to the local filesystem.

Usage:
- This tool will overwrite the existing file if there is one at the provided path.
- If this is an existing file, you MUST use the Read tool first to read the file's contents. This tool will fail if you did not read the file first.
- Prefer the Edit tool for modifying existing files — it only sends the diff. Only use this tool to create new files or for complete rewrites.
- NEVER create documentation files (*.md) or README files unless explicitly requested by the User.
- Only use emojis if the user explicitly requests it. Avoid writing emojis to files unless asked.

content.content:
1	# Implementation Plan: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	**Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)
4	
5	**Date**: 2026-10-12 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)
6	
7	**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md`,
8	`docs/input/requirements.md` §1 (RF01), §6.2 (`/entries`, `/media/ocr`), §9 (data model
9	reference), §13 (technical constraints), and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on F000
10	(`specs/001-foundation/`) and RF03 (`specs/002-biometric-auth-vault/`), both already implemented.
11	
12	## Summary
13	
14	RF01 gives Home/Chat's composer a real "+" button (F000 shipped none — research.md R9) that opens
15	a bottom-sheet Insertion Modal with three tabs: Texto (free text), Áudio (auto-starts recording on
16	tab activation), Foto (camera/gallery choice). Confirming Save — tapping "Salvar" for Texto,
17	tapping stop for Áudio, or supplying an image for Foto (research.md R6) — runs the minimal
18	recognition this unit owns (on-device Whisper transcription for audio, the backend's existing
19	`media-ocr` call for photo, per the spec's resolved Clarification) and then creates exactly one
20	journal entry through a brand-new `entries` feature's shared `CreateEntryUseCase` — the same seam
21	`requirements.md`'s RF10 text already names and will extend later, never bypass (research.md R8).
22	Recognition and the entry-creation call both show only a plain, generic loading indicator;
23	dedicated multi-state recognition screens, an editable review step, and modality-specific retry
24	affordances are explicitly RF02's to build, not this unit's (FR-007). An offline Save is blocked
25	before any network call is attempted, via a new cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` (research.md
26	R5) that later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) can reuse. No backend/contract change.
27	
28	## Technical Context
29	
30	**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
31	F000/RF03, no new pin needed.
32	
33	**Primary Dependencies** (additions on top of F000/RF03's stack):
34	- `record` — real-time microphone capture with a live amplitude signal (research.md R1).
35	- `whisper_ggml` — on-device speech-to-text; **fixed by Constitution Principle II**, not a choice
36	  (research.md R2).
37	- `image_picker` — camera/gallery photo selection (research.md R3).
38	- `connectivity_plus` — interface-level online/offline check powering the new `ConnectivityChecker`
39	  (research.md R5).
40	- `path_provider` — resolves a writable directory for the one-time Whisper model-asset copy
41	  (research.md R2).
42	- Reused unchanged from F000/RF03: `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `dio` (via `ApiClient`), `get_it`,
43	  `equatable`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. `flutter_secure_storage`/`local_auth`/`crypto` are
44	  not touched by this unit.
45	
46	**Storage**: No new local database and no new secure-storage key. The only new "storage" this unit
47	introduces is in-memory: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s `cachedEntries` list (process lifetime, via
48	`get_it`'s `lazySingleton` — same pattern as RF03's `VaultRepository`) and the two bloc-private
49	temp-file paths (`_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath`) that exist only while the modal is open,
50	to support FR-009's retry-without-recapture. The temp WAV/JPEG files themselves live wherever
51	`record`/`image_picker` write them (OS-managed app sandbox temp/cache dirs) — this unit does not
52	manage their cleanup beyond what `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` deletes explicitly.
53	
54	**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, identical to F000/RF03; coverage via
55	`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter for the RNF07 gate, now also
56	covering `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/`. `record`,
57	`image_picker`, and `whisper_ggml` all have no platform channel under `flutter_test` — see
58	quickstart.md for the manual iOS Simulator verification Stories 1–4 and their Edge Cases need.
59	
60	**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` raised from
61	`15.0` to `15.6` (research.md R2, `whisper_ggml`'s documented floor) across all three build
62	configurations in `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`. Three new `Info.plist` usage-description
63	strings (`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`,
64	`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` — research.md R1/R3); no other native project change.
65	
66	**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app. This unit adds two new feature folders —
67	`lib/features/entries/` (the shared entry-creation seam, research.md R8) and
68	`lib/features/capture/` (the Insertion Modal UI and its audio/photo pipelines) — and touches one
69	existing F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`, to add the real "+" button — research.md R9). No
70	backend/server code, no change to `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`.
71	
72	**Performance Goals**: RNF01 — every network call this unit makes (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`)
73	shows the existing plain loading indicator (`DesignTokens.sizeLoadingIndicator`/
74	`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`, already present from F000/RF03) whenever it exceeds 300 ms; the one
75	local action with its own 100 ms bar is the Texto tab's "Salvar" enabled/disabled toggle as the
76	field's emptiness changes, and the Áudio tab's recording starting "immediately" on tab activation.
77	
78	**Constraints**:
79	- No RF02 dedicated recognition-state screens (processing/transcribed/recognized/error with their
80	  own styling), no editable review step, no modality-specific retry affordances ("Tentar
81	  novamente" styled to match RF02's named Erro states, "Salvar só a foto") — FR-007, research.md
82	  R11. This unit's own failure/retry UI is deliberately plainer than the prototype's named "Erro"
83	  states, per spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1.
84	- No RF04/RF05/RF06/RF07/RF08/RF09/RF10 behavior, no extension feature (manual tags/categories,
85	  action plans, persona selection) — FR-012.
86	- No backend/contract/config change (FR-013) — only two already-existing functions are called
87	  (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`), with request bodies limited to exactly the fields this unit
88	  needs (data-model.md).
89	- Audio content never reaches the backend (Constitution Principle II) — transcription is entirely
90	  on-device via `whisper_ggml`; only its resulting text is ever sent, as an `entries-create` body.
91	- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V); `entries/domain/` and `capture/domain/`
92	  stay free of `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, and `whisper_ggml` types — see
93	  contracts/*.md.
94	- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — this
95	  unit needs no new token (research.md R10), reusing F000/RF03's existing scale entirely.
96	
97	**Scale/Scope**: 1 new "+" button on an existing screen (research.md R9); 1 new bottom-sheet page
98	(`InsertionModalPage`) with 3 tab widgets, backed by 1 screen-scoped bloc covering 11 sub-states
99	across the three tabs (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md); 2 new feature folders
100	(`entries`, `capture`) with 2 new network-backed repositories (`EntriesRepository`,
101	`PhotoRecognitionRepository`, both `Either<Failure, T>`) plus 2 new device-only repositories
102	(`AudioCaptureRepository`, `PhotoCaptureRepository`) and 1 on-device-only repository
103	(`AudioTranscriptionRepository`, `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>` — not the backend taxonomy); 1 new
104	cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` in `core/network/`, reusable by later offline-gated units.
105	
106	## Constitution Check
107	
108	*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this
109	section.*
110	
111	| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
112	|---|---|---|
113	| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only; this unit's one genuinely silent spot (how "confirming Save" maps to a concrete user action per modality, and how far this unit's own failure UI may deviate from the prototype's named Erro states) was resolved by reasonable technical judgment, documented in research.md R6/R11, building directly on spec.md's own already-resolved Clarifications rather than reopening them. |
114	| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | `flutter_bloc`/`fpdart`/`mocktail` reused as-is. `whisper_ggml` is Principle II's explicit, non-negotiable choice for speech-to-text (research.md R2) — audio never reaches the backend. `record`/`image_picker`/`connectivity_plus`/`path_provider` are incidental, non-conflicting additions needed to implement literal FRs (FR-004/FR-005/FR-010), in the same category RF03's `crypto` addition already set precedent for. |
115	| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | Exactly two already-existing functions called: `entries-create` (`POST /entries`) and `media-ocr` (`POST /media/ocr`), both via `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>`, `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (user session, `bearerAuth`), reusing `ApiClient` unmodified. No AI provider is ever called directly by the app — both AI-involved steps (PII/embedding on `entries-create`, vision/OCR on `media-ocr`) happen inside the backend. Audio transcription stays entirely on-device, per Principle II. |
116	| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | All three tabs render from `design_tokens.dart`'s existing scale, no new token needed (research.md R10). The one deliberate fidelity carve-out — this unit's plainer failure/retry UI not reproducing the prototype's named "Erro" states — is explicitly sanctioned by spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1, not a new deviation (research.md R11). |
117	| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | `lib/features/entries/{data,domain,presentation}` (presentation unused by this unit's scope — no entries/-owned screen yet, intentionally left for RF07), `lib/features/capture/{data,domain,presentation}`. No domain type in either feature imports `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, or a `data/` class — contracts/*.md. |
118	| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | Every network call (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) reuses the existing >300 ms loading-indicator convention; the Áudio tab's "starts immediately" and the Texto tab's enabled/disabled toggle are both purely local, well under 100 ms. |
119	| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF01 | PII stripping and retention are backend-side policies on `entries-create`, unchanged by this unit; RLS is already enforced server-side on every call this unit makes. |
120	| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A to RF01 | Belongs to the Settings/RF09 unit. |
121	| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | `entries/domain/` and `capture/domain/` import no `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, or `data/` class — enforced by the same `always_use_package_imports`/`domain_purity_test.dart` convention F000 set up. |
122	| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | Every usecase in this unit (`CreateEntryUseCase`, `SaveTextEntryUseCase`, `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`, `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`) is a pure orchestration of injected repository interfaces, straightforwardly testable against fakes/mocks — see quickstart.md's test list. |
123	| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS, with one documented, spec-sanctioned carve-out | Texto/Áudio-Gravando/Foto-Captura rendered per prototype-extract.md §2.3; the audio/photo failure states are this unit's own plainer UI, not the prototype's named "Erro" states — see research.md R11 for why this is not a fidelity gap. |
124	| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PARTIAL BY DESIGN, not a violation | Consistent with F000/RF03's own note: RNF09's 15-scenario target (5 write endpoints × 3 failures) is reached incrementally across the delivery order. This unit contributes full timeout/malformed/offline coverage for 2 of the 5 write endpoints (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) — 6/15 scenarios, cumulative with F000's auth endpoints. `AudioTranscriptionRepository` deliberately does **not** return `Either<Failure, T>` (the backend taxonomy) — research.md R7, the same scoping precedent RF03's R5 already established for its own local-only repository. |
125	
126	*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*
127

225	**Structure Decision**: Same single Flutter app F000/RF03 established. RF01 is additive
226	(`features/entries/`, `features/capture/`, `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart`) plus one
227	one-line-equivalent edit to an existing F000 file's composer widget — chosen over folding
228	entry-creation logic into `capture/` (research.md R8, directly driven by RF10's own "entries
229	feature" wording in `requirements.md`). No new top-level directory beyond a small `assets/models/`
230	addition for the bundled Whisper model, no change to `docs/`, `.specify/`, or prior units' spec
231	directories.
232	
233	## Complexity Tracking
234	
235	*No entries — every addition below is either one of the constitution's implicitly-open choices
236	(a device-capability package needed to implement a literal FR, same category as RF03's `crypto`)
237	or `whisper_ggml` itself, which Principle II fixes outright rather than leaving open.*
238	
239	## Post-Design Constitution Check
240	
241	Re-evaluated after Phase 1 (data-model.md, contracts/, quickstart.md):
242	
243	- `EntriesRepository`/`AudioCaptureRepository`/`AudioTranscriptionRepository`/
244	  `PhotoCaptureRepository`/`PhotoRecognitionRepository` (contracts/*.md) all expose only domain
245	  types (`Entry`, `EntrySource`, `RecognitionFailure`, `OcrResult`, `PhotoSource`, plain
246	  `bool`/`String`/`Stream<double>`) — no `record`, `image_picker`, or `whisper_ggml` class crosses
247	  into `domain/`. RNF06/Principle V confirmed before any code exists.
248	- `EntriesRepository.create()` and `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` are the only two
249	  repositories this unit adds that return `Either<Failure, T>`, reusing F000's existing `Failure`
250	  hierarchy unchanged — no new `Failure` subtype needed, since `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` was
251	  already present from F000 and fits the illegible-image Edge Case exactly.
252	  `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` deliberately returns `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>`
253	  instead (research.md R7) — re-checked against RF03's own R5 precedent and found to be the same
254	  shape of decision, not a new kind of exception to RNF09.

# Implementation Plan: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)

**Date**: 2026-10-12 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/003-multimodal-capture/spec.md`,
`docs/input/requirements.md` §1 (RF01), §6.2 (`/entries`, `/media/ocr`), §9 (data model
reference), §13 (technical constraints), and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`. Depends on F000
(`specs/001-foundation/`) and RF03 (`specs/002-biometric-auth-vault/`), both already implemented.

## Summary

RF01 gives Home/Chat's composer a real "+" button (F000 shipped none — research.md R9) that opens
a bottom-sheet Insertion Modal with three tabs: Texto (free text), Áudio (auto-starts recording on
tab activation), Foto (camera/gallery choice). Confirming Save — tapping "Salvar" for Texto,
tapping stop for Áudio, or supplying an image for Foto (research.md R6) — runs the minimal
recognition this unit owns (on-device Whisper transcription for audio, the backend's existing
`media-ocr` call for photo, per the spec's resolved Clarification) and then creates exactly one
journal entry through a brand-new `entries` feature's shared `CreateEntryUseCase` — the same seam
`requirements.md`'s RF10 text already names and will extend later, never bypass (research.md R8).
Recognition and the entry-creation call both show only a plain, generic loading indicator;
dedicated multi-state recognition screens, an editable review step, and modality-specific retry
affordances are explicitly RF02's to build, not this unit's (FR-007). An offline Save is blocked
before any network call is attempted, via a new cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` (research.md
R5) that later offline-gated units (RF04, RF06) can reuse. No backend/contract change.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable), pinned via `.fvmrc` — unchanged from
F000/RF03, no new pin needed.

**Primary Dependencies** (additions on top of F000/RF03's stack):
- `record` — real-time microphone capture with a live amplitude signal (research.md R1).
- `whisper_ggml` — on-device speech-to-text; **fixed by Constitution Principle II**, not a choice
  (research.md R2).
- `image_picker` — camera/gallery photo selection (research.md R3).
- `connectivity_plus` — interface-level online/offline check powering the new `ConnectivityChecker`
  (research.md R5).
- `path_provider` — resolves a writable directory for the one-time Whisper model-asset copy
  (research.md R2).
- Reused unchanged from F000/RF03: `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart`, `dio` (via `ApiClient`), `get_it`,
  `equatable`; dev-only `mocktail`, `bloc_test`. `flutter_secure_storage`/`local_auth`/`crypto` are
  not touched by this unit.

**Storage**: No new local database and no new secure-storage key. The only new "storage" this unit
introduces is in-memory: `EntriesRepositoryImpl`'s `cachedEntries` list (process lifetime, via
`get_it`'s `lazySingleton` — same pattern as RF03's `VaultRepository`) and the two bloc-private
temp-file paths (`_pendingAudioPath`/`_pendingImagePath`) that exist only while the modal is open,
to support FR-009's retry-without-recapture. The temp WAV/JPEG files themselves live wherever
`record`/`image_picker` write them (OS-managed app sandbox temp/cache dirs) — this unit does not
manage their cleanup beyond what `AudioCaptureRepository.discard()` deletes explicitly.

**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` + `mocktail`, identical to F000/RF03; coverage via
`fvm flutter test --coverage`, same `lib/**/domain/**` lcov filter for the RNF07 gate, now also
covering `lib/features/entries/domain/` and `lib/features/capture/domain/`. `record`,
`image_picker`, and `whisper_ggml` all have no platform channel under `flutter_test` — see
quickstart.md for the manual iOS Simulator verification Stories 1–4 and their Edge Cases need.

**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait only — unchanged. `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` raised from
`15.0` to `15.6` (research.md R2, `whisper_ggml`'s documented floor) across all three build
configurations in `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj`. Three new `Info.plist` usage-description
strings (`NSMicrophoneUsageDescription`, `NSCameraUsageDescription`,
`NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` — research.md R1/R3); no other native project change.

**Project Type**: Same single Flutter mobile app. This unit adds two new feature folders —
`lib/features/entries/` (the shared entry-creation seam, research.md R8) and
`lib/features/capture/` (the Insertion Modal UI and its audio/photo pipelines) — and touches one
existing F000 file (`home_chat_shell_page.dart`, to add the real "+" button — research.md R9). No
backend/server code, no change to `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`.

**Performance Goals**: RNF01 — every network call this unit makes (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`)
shows the existing plain loading indicator (`DesignTokens.sizeLoadingIndicator`/
`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`, already present from F000/RF03) whenever it exceeds 300 ms; the one
local action with its own 100 ms bar is the Texto tab's "Salvar" enabled/disabled toggle as the
field's emptiness changes, and the Áudio tab's recording starting "immediately" on tab activation.

**Constraints**:
- No RF02 dedicated recognition-state screens (processing/transcribed/recognized/error with their
  own styling), no editable review step, no modality-specific retry affordances ("Tentar
  novamente" styled to match RF02's named Erro states, "Salvar só a foto") — FR-007, research.md
  R11. This unit's own failure/retry UI is deliberately plainer than the prototype's named "Erro"
  states, per spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1.
- No RF04/RF05/RF06/RF07/RF08/RF09/RF10 behavior, no extension feature (manual tags/categories,
  action plans, persona selection) — FR-012.
- No backend/contract/config change (FR-013) — only two already-existing functions are called
  (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`), with request bodies limited to exactly the fields this unit
  needs (data-model.md).
- Audio content never reaches the backend (Constitution Principle II) — transcription is entirely
  on-device via `whisper_ggml`; only its resulting text is ever sent, as an `entries-create` body.
- Clean Architecture, 3 layers per feature (Principle V); `entries/domain/` and `capture/domain/`
  stay free of `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, and `whisper_ggml` types — see
  contracts/*.md.
- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV/RNF08) — this
  unit needs no new token (research.md R10), reusing F000/RF03's existing scale entirely.

**Scale/Scope**: 1 new "+" button on an existing screen (research.md R9); 1 new bottom-sheet page
(`InsertionModalPage`) with 3 tab widgets, backed by 1 screen-scoped bloc covering 11 sub-states
across the three tabs (contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md); 2 new feature folders
(`entries`, `capture`) with 2 new network-backed repositories (`EntriesRepository`,
`PhotoRecognitionRepository`, both `Either<Failure, T>`) plus 2 new device-only repositories
(`AudioCaptureRepository`, `PhotoCaptureRepository`) and 1 on-device-only repository
(`AudioTranscriptionRepository`, `Either<RecognitionFailure, T>` — not the backend taxonomy); 1 new
cross-cutting `ConnectivityChecker` in `core/network/`, reusable by later offline-gated units.

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this
section.*

| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only; this unit's one genuinely silent spot (how "confirming Save" maps to a concrete user action per modality, and how far this unit's own failure UI may deviate from the prototype's named Erro states) was resolved by reasonable technical judgment, documented in research.md R6/R11, building directly on spec.md's own already-resolved Clarifications rather than reopening them. |
| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | `flutter_bloc`/`fpdart`/`mocktail` reused as-is. `whisper_ggml` is Principle II's explicit, non-negotiable choice for speech-to-text (research.md R2) — audio never reaches the backend. `record`/`image_picker`/`connectivity_plus`/`path_provider` are incidental, non-conflicting additions needed to implement literal FRs (FR-004/FR-005/FR-010), in the same category RF03's `crypto` addition already set precedent for. |
| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | Exactly two already-existing functions called: `entries-create` (`POST /entries`) and `media-ocr` (`POST /media/ocr`), both via `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>`, `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (user session, `bearerAuth`), reusing `ApiClient` unmodified. No AI provider is ever called directly by the app — both AI-involved steps (PII/embedding on `entries-create`, vision/OCR on `media-ocr`) happen inside the backend. Audio transcription stays entirely on-device, per Principle II. |
| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | All three tabs render from `design_tokens.dart`'s existing scale, no new token needed (research.md R10). The one deliberate fidelity carve-out — this unit's plainer failure/retry UI not reproducing the prototype's named "Erro" states — is explicitly sanctioned by spec.md's own resolved Clarification 1, not a new deviation (research.md R11). |
| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | `lib/features/entries/{data,domain,presentation}` (presentation unused by this unit's scope — no entries/-owned screen yet, intentionally left for RF07), `lib/features/capture/{data,domain,presentation}`. No domain type in either feature imports `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, or a `data/` class — contracts/*.md. |
| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | Every network call (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) reuses the existing >300 ms loading-indicator convention; the Áudio tab's "starts immediately" and the Texto tab's enabled/disabled toggle are both purely local, well under 100 ms. |
| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to RF01 | PII stripping and retention are backend-side policies on `entries-create`, unchanged by this unit; RLS is already enforced server-side on every call this unit makes. |
| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A to RF01 | Belongs to the Settings/RF09 unit. |
| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | `entries/domain/` and `capture/domain/` import no `package:flutter`, `record`, `image_picker`, `whisper_ggml`, or `data/` class — enforced by the same `always_use_package_imports`/`domain_purity_test.dart` convention F000 set up. |
| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | Every usecase in this unit (`CreateEntryUseCase`, `SaveTextEntryUseCase`, `SaveAudioEntryUseCase`, `SavePhotoEntryUseCase`) is a pure orchestration of injected repository interfaces, straightforwardly testable against fakes/mocks — see quickstart.md's test list. |
| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS, with one documented, spec-sanctioned carve-out | Texto/Áudio-Gravando/Foto-Captura rendered per prototype-extract.md §2.3; the audio/photo failure states are this unit's own plainer UI, not the prototype's named "Erro" states — see research.md R11 for why this is not a fidelity gap. |
| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PARTIAL BY DESIGN, not a violation | Consistent with F000/RF03's own note: RNF09's 15-scenario target (5 write endpoints × 3 failures) is reached incrementally across the delivery order. This unit contributes full timeout/malformed/offline coverage for 2 of the 5 write endpoints (`entries-create`, `media-ocr`) — 6/15 scenarios, cumulative with F000's auth endpoints. `AudioTranscriptionRepository` deliberately does **not** return `Either<Failure, T>` (the backend taxonomy) — research.md R7, the same scoping precedent RF03's R5 already established for its own local-only repository. |

*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*

## Project Structure

### Source Code (repository root)

1	# Feature Specification: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	**Feature Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)
4	
5	**Created**: 2026-10-12
6	
7	**Status**: Draft
8	
9	**Input**: User description: "P-RF01 — Multimodal capture: Let the user create a journal entry by text, audio recording or photo, from the Insertion Modal, per docs/input/requirements.md section 1 (RF01) and its acceptance criteria. Prototype states: Insertion modal — 'Texto', 'Áudio — Gravando', 'Foto — Captura' (prototype extract, section 2.3), opened by the '+' button of Home/Chat. Backend: POST /entries with source manual/audio/photo. Depends on F000, RF03. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."
10	
11	## Clarifications
12	
13	### Session 2026-10-12
14	
15	- Q: When a user stops recording audio or captures a photo in this unit, how should Save behave, given RF02 (speech-to-text/OCR) is an explicitly later unit and the prototype states listed for this unit stop at "Gravando" and "Captura"? → A: RF01 performs the minimal on-device transcription (audio) or backend OCR call (photo) needed to produce text content inline, as part of confirming Save, shown with only a plain/generic loading indicator — not RF02's dedicated "Processando / Transcrito / Reconhecido / Erro" screens, their editable-text review step, or their specific retry affordances ("Tentar novamente", "Salvar só a foto"). This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
16	- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
17	- Q: The backend's `POST /media/ocr` response carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text — does a `low`-confidence recognition get treated any differently from `high`-confidence before Save completes? → A: No. This unit's scope (FR-007) stops at automatically producing recognized text before Save; any quality gating, warning, or review step keyed to confidence is exactly the kind of recognition-quality handling RF02 owns (its "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review states, deliberately deferred here). Confidence is therefore ignored in this unit: any non-empty recognized text, regardless of confidence, proceeds to Save normally; only the already-specified zero-usable-text case (Edge Cases) is treated as a failure. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
18	
19	## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*
20	
21	### User Story 1 - Writing a journal entry as text (Priority: P1)
22	
23	A user wants to quickly note something in words. They tap "+" on Home/Chat, the Insertion Modal opens on its "Texto" tab, they write freely in the text field, and tap "Salvar". The modal closes and the note now exists as one of their journal entries.
24	
25	**Why this priority**: The simplest and fully self-contained of the three capture paths — it has no dependency on recognition of any kind, so it is the first thing that must work end to end.
26	
27	**Independent Test**: Can be fully tested by tapping "+", typing text into the Texto tab, tapping "Salvar", and confirming a new entry with that exact text and origin "manual" now exists, and the modal has closed back to Home/Chat.
28	
29	**Acceptance Scenarios**:
30	
31	1. **Given** Home/Chat is open, **When** the user taps "+", **Then** the Insertion Modal opens as an overlay on top of Home/Chat (which stays in place underneath), defaulted to the "Texto" tab with an empty field.
32	2. **Given** the Texto tab with text typed into the field, **When** the user taps "Salvar", **Then** a new journal entry is created with that text as its content and origin "manual", and the modal closes, returning to Home/Chat.

46

63

76

80

88

96	## Requirements *(mandatory)*
97	
98	### Functional Requirements
99

102	- **FR-003**: The "Texto" tab MUST provide a free multiline text field and a "Salvar" action that is unavailable while the field is empty.

113	
114	### Key Entities
115	
116	- **Journal Entry**: A persisted record with text content, an origin (`manual`, `audio`, or `photo` for this unit), and a creation time; structurally identical regardless of which modality produced it, and immutable once created.

It is entirely discarded if the capture is abandoned, and never itself becomes a persisted entry.
118

120	
121	### Measurable Outcomes

# Feature Specification: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

**Feature Branch**: `003-multimodal-capture` (spec directory only — no git branch was created automatically; none of this repo's extension hooks are configured)

**Created**: 2026-10-12

**Status**: Draft

**Input**: User description: "P-RF01 — Multimodal capture: Let the user create a journal entry by text, audio recording or photo, from the Insertion Modal, per docs/input/requirements.md section 1 (RF01) and its acceptance criteria. Prototype states: Insertion modal — 'Texto', 'Áudio — Gravando', 'Foto — Captura' (prototype extract, section 2.3), opened by the '+' button of Home/Chat. Backend: POST /entries with source manual/audio/photo. Depends on F000, RF03. Do not implement features of later units, extension features (requirements section 2), or change the backend."

## Clarifications

### Session 2026-10-12

- Q: When a user stops recording audio or captures a photo in this unit, how should Save behave, given RF02 (speech-to-text/OCR) is an explicitly later unit and the prototype states listed for this unit stop at "Gravando" and "Captura"? → A: RF01 performs the minimal on-device transcription (audio) or backend OCR call (photo) needed to produce text content inline, as part of confirming Save, shown with only a plain/generic loading indicator — not RF02's dedicated "Processando / Transcrito / Reconhecido / Erro" screens, their editable-text review step, or their specific retry affordances ("Tentar novamente", "Salvar só a foto"). This is the only reading under which RF01 alone satisfies its own stated acceptance criterion that all three modalities "result in the same persisted-entry format," since entries are immutable (no `PATCH`/`DELETE /entries/:id`) and therefore cannot be corrected after creation — recognition must happen before the entry exists. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
- Q: After a successful Save, the modal closes back to Home/Chat — but Home/Chat never renders journal entries (those appear only in the later "Meus Registros" unit, RF07). What should FR-011's "reflected in the app's state" actually look like on Home/Chat itself? → A: Nothing new is shown on Home/Chat. The prototype documents no confirmation screen, toast, or any other on-screen change for this flow, and inventing one would conflict with Principle IV's visual-fidelity constraint (faithfulness to a frozen prototype that defines no such state) as well as SC-003's "no required intermediate screens." "Reflected in the app's state" means only that the newly created entry is added to the app's local entries store/cache — the same store later units (e.g., RF07) will read from — not that Home/Chat's UI changes in any visible way. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principles I and IV, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)
- Q: The backend's `POST /media/ocr` response carries a `confidence: "high"|"low"` field alongside the recognized text — does a `low`-confidence recognition get treated any differently from `high`-confidence before Save completes? → A: No. This unit's scope (FR-007) stops at automatically producing recognized text before Save; any quality gating, warning, or review step keyed to confidence is exactly the kind of recognition-quality handling RF02 owns (its "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido" review states, deliberately deferred here). Confidence is therefore ignored in this unit: any non-empty recognized text, regardless of confidence, proceeds to Save normally; only the already-specified zero-usable-text case (Edge Cases) is treated as a failure. (Resolved by technical judgment per user direction, applying Constitution Principle I, where the input docs are silent on this exact boundary.)

11

13	schema on every response, so none is optional to model (research.md R8).
14	
15	| Field | Type | Notes |
16	|---|---|---|

# Data Model: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§1, 6.2, 9 (data model reference), §13, and
`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/entries` and `/media/ocr` schemas. This unit introduces
one new backend-shaped entity (`Entry`, read from a contract the backend already defines — no
schema change) and one ephemeral, device-only, non-persisted "entity" (Capture Session, modeled as
presentation state, not a domain type — see research.md R8 for why `Entry`/`EntriesRepository`
live in a new `entries` feature, separate from `capture`).

## Entry (`lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart`)

The full shape of `POST /entries`' response — every field below is `required` in the OpenAPI
schema on every response, so none is optional to model (research.md R8).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` (uuid) | Server-assigned. |
| `content` | `String` | 1–20000 chars; the text this unit always supplies non-empty (FR-003/Edge Cases — never an empty/near-empty entry). |
| `source` | `EntrySource` | `manual` \| `audio` \| `photo` for this unit (see below — `chat` is RF10's addition). |
| `chatMessageId` | `String?` (uuid) | Always `null` for every entry this unit creates. |
| `occurredAt` | `DateTime` | Server-assigned; this unit never sends its own value in the request. |
| `tags` | `List<EntryTag>` | Always empty for a freshly created entry (tags are the manual-tagging extension, out of scope — requirements.md §2); modeled so later units reading an `Entry` don't need a second type. |
| `piiStatus` | `PiiStatus` (`pending`\|`clean`\|`flagged`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; this unit does not branch on it. |
| `piiSpans` | `List<PiiSpan>` | As returned; not rendered by this unit. |
| `embeddingStatus` | `EmbeddingStatus` (`pending`\|`ready`\|`failed`) | Backend-computed; not rendered by this unit. |
| `mediaDurationSeconds` | `int?` | This unit never sends it in the request, so it is always `null` on the response to an entry this unit creates. |
| `serverRevision` | `int` | Opaque; not used by this unit. |
| `createdAt` | `DateTime` | — |
| `updatedAt` | `DateTime` | — |

```dart
enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo }         // `chat` added by RF10, not here (research.md R8)
enum PiiStatus { pending, clean, flagged, failed }
enum EmbeddingStatus { pending, ready, failed }

class EntryTag { final String id; final String name; }
class PiiSpan { final int start; final int end; final String type; }
```

**Validation rule**: `content` is never sent empty or whitespace-only — enforced before any of the
three save usecases ever calls `CreateEntryUseCase` (Texto: the "Salvar" action is itself disabled
on an empty field, FR-003; Audio/Photo: an empty/whitespace recognized result is treated as a
recognition failure, not forwarded to entry creation — Edge Cases).

## `EntriesRepository` (`lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart`)

```dart
abstract class EntriesRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({required String content, required EntrySource source});
  List<Entry> get cachedEntries;   // FR-011's "local entries store/cache" — in-memory, this process's lifetime
}
```

- `create()` posts to `entries-create` via the existing, unmodified `ApiClient`/`Failure` hierarchy
  — no new `Failure` subtype (every backend error this call can realistically return —
  `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `PII_CHECK_FAILED`, `EMBEDDING_FAILED`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`,
  `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `RATE_LIMITED` — already exists in `core/network/failure.dart`).
- `EntriesRepositoryImpl` is registered as a `get_it` `lazySingleton` (the same pattern
  `VaultRepository` uses for its own in-memory, process-lifetime state — RF03 research.md R3) so
  `cachedEntries` survives across modal opens/closes without a local database. On a successful
  `create()`, the returned `Entry` is appended to this in-memory list before the `Either` is
  returned to the caller. Nothing in this unit ever *reads* `cachedEntries` back out for display —
  it exists purely so RF07 (the first unit that reads entries for a screen) has something to read
  from day one, per FR-011's explicit forward reference to "Meus Registros, RF07."

## `CreateEntryUseCase` (`lib/features/entries/domain/usecases/create_entry_usecase.dart`)

```dart
class CreateEntryUseCase {
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> call(String content, EntrySource source) =>
      repository.create(content: content, source: source);
}
```

The one and only sanctioned way any other feature creates an entry (research.md R8) — `capture`'s
three save usecases below depend on this, never on `EntriesRepository` directly.

## Capture Session (presentation-only state — not a domain entity, not persisted)

Spec.md's Key Entities names this as "ephemeral, device-only state that exists only while the
Insertion Modal is open" — in this codebase's existing convention (mirrors RF03's "Presentation-
only state" section: `VaultMode`, the in-progress first PIN entry), this is `InsertionModalBloc`'s
own state plus two bloc-private fields, not a type any other layer sees:

| Held where | What | Lifetime |
|---|---|---|
| `InsertionModalState` (public, see contracts/insertion-modal-bloc.md) | active tab + that tab's own idle/recording/saving/failure sub-state + the Texto draft text | One `InsertionModalBloc` instance per modal open; discarded (never persisted) when the modal closes, satisfying FR-002's "reset every tab... each time the modal is freshly opened" by construction — a fresh bloc is created on every `showModalBottomSheet` call. |
| `_pendingAudioPath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The WAV file path `AudioCaptureRepository` wrote to, kept only so a failed transcribe-or-save can retry (FR-009) without re-recording. Cleared on successful save, on modal close, or on switching away from the Áudio tab (Edge Cases: switching tabs mid-recording discards it). | Same as above. |
| `_pendingImagePath` (bloc-private `String?`) | The JPEG file path `PhotoCaptureRepository` returned, kept for the same FR-009 retry-without-recapture reason. | Same as above. |

No field here is ever written to disk or to the backend as its own record — only a *successful*
recognition's resulting text ever becomes part of an `Entry` via `CreateEntryUseCase`.

## State transitions (per modality, per research.md R6: "confirming Save" is a different trigger each time)

```
Modal opens (showModalBottomSheet, fresh InsertionModalBloc)
  -> InsertionModalTexto(text: '')                              # FR-002 default tab

[Texto tab]
  TextDraftChanged(text) -> InsertionModalTexto(text)            # Salvar enabled iff text.trim().isNotEmpty (FR-003)
  SaveTextSubmitted (text non-empty, not already in flight)
    -> InsertionModalTextoSaving(text)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
        CreateEntryUseCase(text, manual)
            Right(entry)  -> entry appended to EntriesRepository.cachedEntries -> modal closes (FR-011)
            Left(failure) -> InsertionModalTextoFailure(text, failure.message)                              (FR-009)

[Áudio tab — recording starts the instant the tab becomes active, FR-004]
  TabSelected(audio)
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.hasPermission() == false -> InsertionModalAudioPermissionDenied
    -> else: AudioCaptureRepository.start() -> InsertionModalAudioRecording(elapsed: 0:00)      # waveform widget subscribes directly to the amplitude stream (research.md R6/contracts)
  (timer ticks update `elapsed` only — no network, no recognition yet)
  AudioStopRequested
    -> path = AudioCaptureRepository.stop(); _pendingAudioPath = path
    -> InsertionModalAudioSaving()                                                               # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
        ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010 — checked before transcribing at all, research.md R5)
        AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(path, lang: 'pt')
            Left(RecognitionFailure.transcriptionError) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(genericMessage)         (FR-009)
            Right(text) where text.trim().isEmpty        -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(noSpeechMessage)       (Edge Cases: silence)
            Right(text) -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, audio)
                Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingAudioPath cleared; modal closes
                Left(failure) -> InsertionModalAudioFailure(failure.message)     # audio file still held — RetryRequested re-enters AudioStopRequested's saving branch without a fresh recording
  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalAudioFailure, _pendingAudioPath != null)
    -> re-run the InsertionModalAudioSaving branch above against the same _pendingAudioPath
  TabSelected(<anything else>) while InsertionModalAudioRecording
    -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard(); _pendingAudioPath = null; emit the target tab's idle state   (Edge Cases)

[Foto tab]
  TabSelected(photo) -> InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                                               # two buttons, no image yet (FR-005)
  PhotoSourceSelected(camera | gallery)
    -> PhotoCaptureRepository.pickImage(source)
        null (user cancelled the OS picker) -> stays InsertionModalFotoCaptura()                   (Edge Cases/User Story 4)
        path -> _pendingImagePath = path; InsertionModalFotoSaving()                                # plain generic loading indicator (FR-007)
            ConnectivityChecker.hasConnection() == false -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(offlineMessage)   (FR-010)
            PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(path)
                Left(OcrNoTextFailure) or Right(text) where text.trim().isEmpty -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(noTextMessage)   (Edge Cases: illegible/blank image)
                Left(otherFailure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)
                Right(text) [confidence ignored — Clarification 3] -> CreateEntryUseCase(text, photo)
                    Right(entry) -> cached; _pendingImagePath cleared; modal closes
                    Left(failure) -> InsertionModalFotoFailure(failure.message)   # image still held — RetryRequested re-enters this branch
  RetryRequested (from InsertionModalFotoFailure, _pendingImagePath != null)
    -> re-run the recognize+create branch above against the same _pendingImagePath

[Any tab, any sub-state] ModalClosed (close button, scrim tap, system back)
  -> AudioCaptureRepository.discard() if a recording is in progress; bloc disposed; nothing persisted  (FR-008, User Story 4)
```

## Backend `Failure` (reused, not redefined) vs. the new local `RecognitionFailure`

| Repository | Return type | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `EntriesRepository.create()` | `Either<Failure, Entry>` | Real network call; reuses F000's closed 13-code hierarchy unchanged. |
| `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize()` | `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` | Real network call to `media-ocr`; `OcrNoTextFailure`/`OCR_NO_TEXT` already exists in `failure.dart` from F000 and covers the illegible/blank-image Edge Case directly. |
| `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe()` | `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>` | On-device only, no network call — `RecognitionFailure` (`emptyResult`\|`transcriptionError`) is a new, small sealed type local to `capture/domain/`, not added to `core/network/failure.dart` (research.md R7). |

Three write-endpoint failure scenarios this unit's own `mocktail` tests cover, toward RNF09's
running 15-scenario total (`entries-create` and `media-ocr` are two of the spec's five write
endpoints):

| Endpoint | Scenario | Expected `Failure` |
|---|---|---|
| `entries-create` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |
| `media-ocr` | Timeout / No connection / Malformed response | `NetworkTimeoutFailure` / `NetworkOfflineFailure` / `ValidationFailure` |

## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)

No additions — see research.md R10. Every value the three tabs need (primary/outline/text
buttons, text field states, `colorError`, `sizeLoadingIndicator`/`strokeWidthLoadingIndicator`,

1	# Research: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture
2	
3	F000's research.md left "local cache" open generically and named no package for audio/photo
4	capture at all (neither existed as a concern yet); RF03's research.md R1 already set the precedent
5	for how this project treats a package that isn't in Principle II's explicit list but is needed to
6	implement a literal FR. This file resolves every such choice RF01 needs, plus the one structural
7	decision (R8) that reconciles this unit's scope with RF10's forward-looking wording in
8	`requirements.md`.
9	
10	## R1 — Audio recording package
11	
12	- **Decision**: `record` (`AudioRecorder`), configured with `RecordConfig(encoder:
13	  AudioEncoder.wav, sampleRate: 16000, numChannels: 1)`.
14	- **Rationale**: FR-004 needs a start/stop recorder plus a live amplitude signal to drive the
15	  prototype's "animated 12-bar waveform" (prototype-extract.md §2.3); `record` is the de-facto
16	  standard Flutter recording plugin (it backs `waveform_recorder` and similar higher-level widgets)
17	  and exposes both `start`/`stop` and `onAmplitudeChanged(Duration)` directly. Recording straight to
18	  16 kHz mono WAV — rather than the plugin's AAC/`m4a` default — means the file hitting
19	  `whisper_ggml` (R2) never needs its bundled FFmpeg conversion step, matching the exact format of
20	  the backend's own test fixture (`docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav`) and
21	  keeping the record→transcribe path format-deterministic end to end.
22	- **Alternatives considered**: `flutter_sound` — a larger, more general-purpose audio toolkit
23	  (playback, streaming, effects) where this unit only ever needs record+stop+amplitude; rejected as
24	  more surface than the requirement calls for. Recording in the default AAC encoder and relying on
25	  `whisper_ggml`'s bundled FFmpeg to convert — rejected as an avoidable extra step and a dependency
26	  on an implicit, undocumented-in-this-project conversion path when the recorder can just emit the
27	  target format directly.
28	- **Permission handling**: `record`'s own `AudioRecorder.hasPermission()` requests the OS
29	  microphone permission itself (no separate `permission_handler` dependency needed). A `false`
30	  result, or recording start throwing on a since-revoked permission, is what the Audio tab's
31	  permission-denied explanatory message (Edge Cases) reacts to.
32	- **Native project note**: requires `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` —
33	  the App Store requires this string before any mic access is even attempted, mirroring how RF03
34	  added `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` for `local_auth` (research.md R1 there).
35	
36	## R2 — On-device transcription package
37	
38	- **Decision**: `whisper_ggml` (Constitution Principle II — fixed, not a choice), using
39	  `WhisperController.transcribe(model: WhisperModel.tiny, audioPath: ..., lang: 'pt')` against the
40	  WAV file R1 produces. The `ggml-tiny` model (quantized `q5_1` variant preferred for size) ships as
41	  a bundled Flutter asset — copied once, on first use, to a writable app-support directory (via
42	  `path_provider`) because the plugin's native loader needs a filesystem path, not an asset handle —
43	  rather than downloaded over the network on first launch.
44	- **Rationale**: Principle II names `whisper_ggml` outright, so the only open questions are model
45	  size/delivery and language. Bundling the model keeps transcription fully on-device and
46	  network-independent from first launch, consistent with "audio content MUST NEVER be sent to the
47	  backend" (Principle II) and with this unit's own offline-write boundary (R5) — a model that had
48	  to be *downloaded* before the first transcription would make an on-device feature secretly
49	  depend on connectivity, undermining the reason it's on-device at all. `lang: 'pt'` is set
50	  explicitly because every UI string and the backend's fixture audio (`expected-transcription.md`)
51	  are Portuguese, and Whisper's multilingual `tiny` model supports it directly — no language
52	  auto-detection step is needed or wanted here.
53	- **Alternatives considered**: Auto-downloading the model from the package's own CDN on first
54	  launch — rejected per the rationale above. A larger model (`base`/`small`) — rejected as an
55	  unrequested accuracy/size trade-off the spec never asks for; `tiny` is the package's own
56	  documented fast/good-accuracy recommendation and keeps the app bundle smaller.
57	- **Native project note**: `whisper_ggml` documents iOS 15.6+ as its minimum; this project's
58	  current `IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` is `15.0` (set by `flutter create`, per F000 research.md R8,
59	  which deliberately left it at the SDK default because nothing until now needed a floor). This
60	  unit raises it to `15.6` across all three build configurations in
61	  `ios/Runner.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj` — a package-forced native change in the same category as
62	  RF03's `Info.plist` addition, not a product decision.
63	
64	## R3 — Photo capture package
65	
66	- **Decision**: `image_picker`, called as `pickImage(source: ImageSource.camera | ImageSource.gallery,
67	  imageQuality: 90)` for both of the Foto tab's two buttons. The non-null `imageQuality` is a
68	  deliberate choice beyond "a reasonable compression value": it forces the plugin's iOS
69	  implementation through its JPEG re-encoding path regardless of the source asset's original
70	  format, which is what makes `mimeType: image/jpeg` always correct for the backend call (R4) even
71	  for the common case of an iOS Photos-library image stored as HEIC — a format `POST /media/ocr`'s
72	  contract does not accept at all (R4).
73	- **Rationale**: FR-005 requires exactly the camera-or-gallery choice the prototype's "Captura"
74	  state shows (two large buttons); `image_picker` is the official Flutter-team plugin for this,
75	  already the de-facto standard, and returns a plain `XFile` (a file path) either way — no
76	  source-specific branching needed past the initial `ImageSource` argument.
77	- **Alternatives considered**: Picking without `imageQuality` and inspecting/transcoding HEIC
78	  output manually (e.g. via the `image` package) — rejected as strictly more code to reach the same
79	  guaranteed-JPEG outcome `imageQuality` already gives for free as a side effect of the plugin's own
80	  documented compression behavior.
81	- **Native project note**: requires `NSCameraUsageDescription` (camera button) and
82	  `NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription` (gallery button) in `Info.plist`, same category as R1's
83	  microphone string.
84	
85	## R4 — Backend OCR call shape
86	
87	- **Decision**: `PhotoRecognitionRepository` base64-encodes the JPEG bytes R3 produces
88	  (`base64Encode` from `dart:convert`, no new package) and calls `media-ocr`
89	  (`POST /media/ocr`) with `{"image": "<base64>", "mimeType": "image/jpeg"}`, reusing `ApiClient`
90	  unmodified. The response's `confidence` field is read into the result but never branched on
91	  (spec.md Clarifications: confidence-based gating is explicitly RF02's concern).
92	- **Rationale**: `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`'s `/media/ocr` schema requires `image`
93	  (a string) and `mimeType` (enum `image/jpeg`/`image/png`/`image/webp` only — no HEIC) with no
94	  separate multipart path; R3's `imageQuality` choice is what guarantees the app only ever sends
95	  one of the three accepted MIME types.
96	- **Alternatives considered**: None — the request shape is dictated entirely by the frozen
97	  contract (Principle III); the only real decision here was R3's upstream format guarantee.
98	
99	## R5 — Blocking Save while offline (FR-010)
100	
101	- **Decision**: A new `core/network/connectivity_checker.dart` (`ConnectivityChecker`, wrapping
102	  `connectivity_plus`'s `Connectivity().checkConnectivity()`) exposes a plain `Future<bool>
103	  hasConnection()` — true unless the result is `ConnectivityResult.none`. Every Save path (text,
104	  audio, photo) checks this *first*, before any transcription/OCR/entry-creation work, and if it is
105	  `false`, fails immediately with `NetworkOfflineFailure` without calling `ApiClient` at all.
106	- **Rationale**: FR-010/SC-005 and the Edge Cases explicitly want the block to happen "without
107	  attempting a network call that cannot succeed" — a reactive catch of `ApiClient`'s own
108	  `NetworkOfflineFailure` (which already exists and already fires on a real failed call) would
109	  satisfy the *error-handling* half of RNF09 but not this specific "don't even try" requirement, so
110	  a proactive, synchronous-feeling pre-check is needed in addition. Checking before transcription
111	  too (not just before the `entries-create` call) gives the snappier "blocked immediately" behavior
112	  FR-010 asks for, and avoids running on-device Whisper inference or an OCR round-trip for a save
113	  that cannot complete regardless. `connectivity_plus` lives in `core/` (not inside the `capture`
114	  feature) because it is the same cross-cutting, interface-level connectivity concern
115	  spec.md's own Assumptions say "already established elsewhere in the product (chat, search)" —
116	  later units (RF04, RF06) blocking their own writes/sends while offline will reuse this exact
117	  checker rather than each growing its own.
118	- **Known limitation, accepted**: `connectivity_plus` reports OS-level interface state (Wi-Fi/
119	  cellular/none), not actual internet reachability — a device on Wi-Fi with no upstream internet
120	  still reads as "connected." Adding a live reachability probe (e.g. pinging the backend) would be
121	  disproportionate machinery for a check whose whole purpose is to avoid an extra network round
122	  trip; the existing reactive `NetworkOfflineFailure` path (R-nothing-new) still catches that
123	  residual case when the real `entries-create` call is attempted.
124	- **Alternatives considered**: Relying solely on `ApiClient`'s existing reactive mapping — rejected
125	  per the "without attempting a network call" wording above. A full reachability ping before every
126	  save — rejected as disproportionate for the stated requirement.
127	
128	## R6 — "Confirming Save" is a different user action per modality
129	
130	- **Decision**: There is no second, explicit "Salvar" tap for the Áudio or Foto tabs. Per spec.md's
131	  own Acceptance Scenarios: for **Texto**, "confirming Save" is the user tapping the tab's "Salvar"
132	  button (User Story 1, FR-003). For **Áudio**, it is the user tapping the stop control (User Story
133	  2 Scenario 2: "the user taps stop... the system automatically transcribes it and completes the
134	  save"). For **Foto**, it is the picker returning a selected/captured image (User Story 3 Scenario
135	  2: "that image is provided... the system automatically extracts its text and completes the
136	  save"). None of the three needs or gets an intermediate editable-text review screen with its own
137	  "Salvar" button — that reviewable state (prototype's "Transcrito"/"Reconhecido") is exactly what
138	  spec.md's Clarification 1 reserves for RF02.
139	- **Rationale**: Re-building a second confirmation tap for audio/photo would recreate the
140	  editable-review step FR-007 explicitly forbids, and would contradict the Acceptance Scenarios'
141	  own wording ("completes the save" as the direct, same-step outcome of stopping/providing — not a
142	  precursor to a later explicit save action). This is the detail most likely to be
143	  over-engineered by accident during implementation, so it is called out here explicitly rather
144	  than left implicit in data-model.md's transition tables alone.
145	- **Alternatives considered**: Adding a plain (non-RF02-styled) "Salvar" button after recognition
146	  succeeds, before creating the entry — rejected: it would be an invented intermediate step with no
147	  basis in the Acceptance Scenarios, and would reintroduce exactly the kind of extra tap SC-003
148	  ("no required intermediate screens") argues against.
149	
150	## R7 — Local recognition failures are not backend `Failure`s
151	
152	- **Decision**: `AudioTranscriptionRepository.transcribe(...)` returns
153	  `Either<RecognitionFailure, String>`, where `RecognitionFailure` is a small new sealed type local
154	  to the `capture` feature's domain layer (`emptyResult | transcriptionError`) — **not** a new
155	  subtype added to `core/network/failure.dart`. `PhotoRecognitionRepository.recognize(...)`, by
156	  contrast, *does* return `Either<Failure, OcrResult>` using the existing, unmodified `Failure`
157	  hierarchy, because it is a real network call to `media-ocr` and the backend's closed taxonomy
158	  already has the exact code this path needs (`OcrNoTextFailure` / `OCR_NO_TEXT`, already present in
159	  `failure.dart` since F000).
160	- **Rationale**: This mirrors RF03's research.md R5 precedent exactly: `core/network/failure.dart`
161	  is scoped to the backend's 13-code closed taxonomy (a *server* response can say
162	  `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`; it cannot say "the microphone recording was silent"). On-device Whisper
163	  returning an empty/whitespace transcript, or throwing internally, is a purely local condition
164	  with no corresponding backend code — forcing it through `Either<Failure, T>` would mean either

166	  "closed" taxonomy's scope. OCR, conversely, is a real backend round trip whose own contract
167	  already names this exact failure mode — no new type needed there at all.
168	- **Alternatives considered**: One shared `Either<Failure, T>` surface for both audio and photo

170	  reason RF03 rejected modeling PIN/biometric outcomes that way: it would grow a taxonomy the

174	
175	- **Decision**: `Entry` (full response shape), `EntriesRepository` (create today; later units add

202	  the only unit using them so far) — rejected, directly contradicts RF10's "entries feature" wording
203	  and would force a disruptive move later. Having `capture/`'s save usecases call
204	  `EntriesRepository.create()` directly, with `CreateEntryUseCase` deferred to whenever RF10 is
205	  built — rejected: RF10's requirement explicitly bans exactly this shape ("never... directly
206	  importing a repository... of the entries feature"), and building the usecase now costs nothing
207	  extra since RF01 needs the same orchestration either way.
208	
209	## R9 — The "+" button does not exist yet
210	
211	- **Decision**: `HomeChatShellPage`'s `_ComposerBar` (`lib/features/home/presentation/pages/

219	  to be "opened by the '+' button on Home/Chat," so this unit is the one that must add it; a plain
220	  `IconButton` in the composer `Row`, wired only to open the modal, is the minimal change that
221	  satisfies FR-001 without touching the still-disabled text field/send icon next to it.

238	  file without every *use* of alpha elsewhere needing a dedicated token.
239	- **No new tokens needed.** Unlike RF03 (which needed `sizeKeypadTapTarget`,

242	  and two large buttons — are all composed from F000's existing spacing/radius/typography scale and

249	  generic retry action, styled from existing tokens (`colorError` text, a ghost/outline button) —
250	  it does **not** reproduce the prototype's specific "Áudio — Erro" / "Foto — Erro" component specs

252	  possível transcrever"/"Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", the specific outline button styled
253	  as that named state, or Foto-Erro's second action "Salvar só a foto").
254	- **Rationale**: This looks, at first glance, like an RNF08 violation ("every screen MUST be
255	  faithful to the prototype") — but RNF08's fidelity obligation applies to states this unit actually
256	  implements. The "Erro" states as named in the prototype are explicitly, by spec.md's own
257	  Clarification 1, RF02's screens to build ("this unit MUST NOT present... a dedicated multi-state
258	  screen... or modality-specific retry affordances such as 'Tentar novamente' or 'Salvar só a
259	  foto'" — FR-007). FR-009 still requires *some* failure-and-retry behavior to exist for this unit's

269	  borrowing its look while structurally not being that state would be a confusing hybrid, not a
270	  faithful implementation of either unit's scope.

# Research: P-RF01 — Multimodal capture

F000's research.md left "local cache" open generically and named no package for audio/photo
capture at all (neither existed as a concern yet); RF03's research.md R1 already set the precedent
for how this project treats a package that isn't in Principle II's explicit list but is needed to
implement a literal FR. This file resolves every such choice RF01 needs, plus the one structural
decision (R8) that reconciles this unit's scope with RF10's forward-looking wording in
`requirements.md`.

## R1 — Audio recording package

- **Decision**: `record` (`AudioRecorder`), configured with `RecordConfig(encoder:
  AudioEncoder.wav, sampleRate: 16000, numChannels: 1)`.
- **Rationale**: FR-004 needs a start/stop recorder plus a live amplitude signal to drive the
  prototype's "animated 12-bar waveform" (prototype-extract.md §2.3); `record` is the de-facto
  standard Flutter recording plugin (it backs `waveform_recorder` and similar higher-level widgets)
  and exposes both `start`/`stop` and `onAmplitudeChanged(Duration)` directly. Recording straight to
  16 kHz mono WAV — rather than the plugin's AAC/`m4a` default — means the file hitting
  `whisper_ggml` (R2) never needs its bundled FFmpeg conversion step, matching the exact format of
  the backend's own test fixture (`docs/input/backend/fixtures/media/audio_fixture_01.wav`) and
  keeping the record→transcribe path format-deterministic end to end.
- **Alternatives considered**: `flutter_sound` — a larger, more general-purpose audio toolkit
  (playback, streaming, effects) where this unit only ever needs record+stop+amplitude; rejected as
  more surface than the requirement calls for. Recording in the default AAC encoder and relying on
  `whisper_ggml`'s bundled FFmpeg to convert — rejected as an avoidable extra step and a dependency
  on an implicit, undocumented-in-this-project conversion path when the recorder can just emit the
  target format directly.
- **Permission handling**: `record`'s own `AudioRecorder.hasPermission()` requests the OS
  microphone permission itself (no separate `permission_handler` dependency needed). A `false`
  result, or recording start throwing on a since-revoked permission, is what the Audio tab's
  permission-denied explanatory message (Edge Cases) reacts to.
- **Native project note**: requires `NSMicrophoneUsageDescription` in `ios/Runner/Info.plist` —
  the App Store requires this string before any mic access is even attempted, mirroring how RF03
  added `NSFaceIDUsageDescription` for `local_auth` (research.md R1 there).

  WAV file R1 produces. The `ggml-tiny` model (quantized `q5_1` variant preferred for size) ships as
  a bundled Flutter asset — copied once, on first use, to a writable app-support directory (via
  `path_provider`) because the plugin's native loader needs a filesystem path, not an asset handle —
  rather than downloaded over the network on first launch.

- **Native project note**: requires `NSCameraUsageDescription` (camera button) and

  microphone string.
